confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant anchors are more reliable; July hostel and hotel rates vary by district and are less certain. Cocktail and wine were set as about 5.5x and 4.5x the beer anchor because direct knowledge is weaker. FX: the latest RBA reading I could confirm is dated 2026-03-20; October 2026 readings could not be verified, so the rate may be stale. It came from search summaries of the RBA table, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Reasoned from Beijing's general price tiers, with reference to other large Chinese tier-1 cities such as Shanghai. Accommodation reflects central Beijing budget and midscale options at summer high-season levels.
